description: This file defines API routes for managing train seat bookings, including seat availability, locking seats, creating bookings, and retrieving user bookings. It uses FastAPI for HTTP endpoints and SQLAlchemy for database interactions.

classes.name: SeatStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of a seat, including lock and booking states.

methods.name: _refresh_locks(db: Session, schedule_id: int)
methods.description: Refreshes seat lock statuses by releasing expired locks for a given schedule.

methods.name: SeatMapResponse availability(schedule_id: int = Query(...), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Returns seat map with lock and booking statuses for a specific schedule.

methods.name: SeatMapResponse lock_seats(payload: LockSeatsRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Locks specified seats for a limited time to allow user checkout.

methods.name: BookingOut create_booking( payload: CreateBookingRequest, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Confirms a booking by converting locked seats into confirmed booking items.

methods.name: List[BookingOut] my_bookings(user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bookings for the current logged-in user.

methods.name: BookingOut get_booking(booking_id: int, user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific booking by ID for the current user.
